name: Customer Skeptic
tagline: A tired senior buyer's read of any marketing asset — scoreline first, then the full flag-by-flag read as a doc.
who: Marketers and founders who want to know what a skeptical buyer actually thinks of a deck, hero copy, or one-pager before it ships.
how: Drop in the asset. The agent reads it as a senior buyer between two other vendor evaluations — pattern-matched, unconvinced, looking for a reason to deprioritize — and answers in chat with a red/yellow/green scoreline, a 1–10 customer-readiness score, and the single highest-leverage fix. The full read lands as a doc: the findings that matter, what's working, the path to a 9, with every competitive claim tagged as anchored, pattern-matched, or reasoning.
